verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly document a non-resident path, covering eligibility, foreign identifiers and registered-agent requirements, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, which block crawling of the SCC site and the filing system, so none of the Commission's pages were read and nothing shows non-resident guidance. The robots.txt walls say nothing about founder guidance, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
